wording: Multiregion genome and epigenome profiling of nine colorectal tumours showed clonally shared early alterations followed, in the late phase, by branching of a parental clone into numerous subclones; known driver alterations were frequent among early and rare among late alterations.
counterevidence_limits: Nine tumours, one centre; region sampling limits subclone detection.
verification_phrases: P05|a parental clone was branched into numerous subclones

wording: Whether late subclonal divergence is mostly neutral is contested: P05's simulation suggests extensive intratumour heterogeneity could be generated by neutral evolution, and P04 presents punctuated ('Big Bang') evolution with predominantly neutral expansion as an alternative to gradualist selection-driven models.
locator: P05 Abstract; P04 section 'Punctuated (Big Bang) Tumor Evolution'
counterevidence_limits: P04 is a narrative review; neutrality tests from frequency spectra are themselves disputed (not yet sourced here).
operationalization: Competing models of tumour divergence: neutral vs selective, gradual vs punctuated
verification_phrases: P05|extensive intratumor heterogeneity could be generated by neutral evolution || P04|An alternative to gradualist models is punctuated

wording: A 2026 review reports evidence that the linear-progression model of tumour evolution is less frequent than expected and that parallel or branched evolution is common, with the clinical consequence that a single primary-tumour biopsy may miss divergent subclones.
locator: P04 section on metastasis and ctDNA
counterevidence_limits: Secondhand report of the cited studies, which were not read here.
operationalization: Divergence = branched rather than linear progression
verification_phrases: P04|parallel or branched evolution is common

wording: In one neutral birth-death growth run to 5,000 cells, the cumulative count of subclonal mutations was approximately but not tightly linear in 1/f (R^2 = 0.958); the pre-registered criterion R^2 >= 0.98 was not supported.
counterevidence_limits: Single run, cell fractions without sequencing noise; the criterion may be too strict for one stochastic realisation. To be tested with replicates in x3.
